title: Finite generation of an abelian etale subsheaf by affine-chart sections
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $F$ an abelian sheaf on the small etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and $G\subseteq F$ a subsheaf. Call $G$ finitely generated if there exist $n\geq0$, affine schemes $U_j$ etale over $X$, and sections $s_j\in F(U_j)$ for $j<n$, such that $G$ is the smallest subsheaf containing all the $s_j$. A subsheaf contains a section if that section lifts through its inclusion into $F$. Equivalently, $G$ is the image of the finite sum of extension-by-zero generators corresponding to these sections (Stacks Tag 03SA). The empty family generates the zero subsheaf.
